name: Can I Help
description: Contributor guidance for any project — matches developer skills to data-backed contribution opportunities. `/can-i-help` collects project-health signals automatically (good-first-issue candidates, test gaps from co-change history, doc drift, bug-spots, open GitHub issues), asks about the developer's background, then matches skills to needs with concrete next steps. Each recommendation includes what to do, why (with the underlying data), how (reads relevant code and explains), and the first step. Three phases: collect (deterministic, no LLM), match (sonnet agent), guide (interactive). Validated on 100 open-source repositories across 8 languages.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **1 agent** and **1 command**.

- **Skills** (1): `can-i-help` (Use when user asks to \"contribute\", \"where can I help\", \"good first issue\", \"what needs work\", \"how to…)
- **Agents** (1): `can-i-help-agent` (Guide contributors to areas where they can help)
- **Commands** (1): `can-i-help` (Find where to contribute to a project - matches your skills to areas that need help, good-first tasks,…)

Installs with `claude plugin install can-i-help@claude-community` from `agent-sh/can-i-help`.
